deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is part of Gauss's correspondence register and postage ledger for 1815, the 'Briefregister'. The page shows 6 March to 29 June, plus the start of July.

**Layout.** Each entry has:
- a date;
- a correspondent under 'Von' (letter received) or 'An' (letter sent);
- the postage paid, in two money columns, 'Convent.' (Conventionsmünze) and 'Cassen' (Cassengeld).

Each money column has two sub-columns, Groschen and Pfennig. The sums only work with 12 Pf = 1 Gr. A brace groups letters that went or came together under one charge.

**Correspondents.** Mostly astronomers, instrument makers and officials: Olbers, von Lindenau, Repsold, Fraunhofer, von Utzschneider, Bessel, Gerling, Nicolai, Encke, Bode, Pfaff, Mollweide, Soldner, Littrow, Herschel, Pond, Brera, the Curatorium, and others.

**What is computed.** A ruled line closes each month, followed by a summary row: number of letters received, number sent, Convent. total, Cassen total.

- **March** (summary row '23 10 6|4 15|10'): includes four letters received and one sent on 2–3 March, listed on the previous page.
  - Received: 4 + 19 = 23 (the 9 March 'Me' is struck out). Sent: 1 + 9 = 10.
  - Convent.: 3gr + 3gr + 4pf = 6 gr 4 pf.
  - Cassen: 2|8 + 3|2 + 3|6 + 0|6 + 3|0 + 0|10 + 1|6 + 0|2 = 15 gr 4 pf on this page. Adding 0|6 from the previous page (Bessel group 0|4, Mathiessen 0|2) gives 15 gr 10 pf.
- **April** (summary row '14 10 6|2 13|7'):
  - 14 received, 10 sent.
  - Convent.: 3|0 + 3|2 = 6|2.
  - Cassen: 0|2 + 1|8 + 5|3 + 0|2 + 0|6 + 0|6 + 1|6 + 0|2 + 0|4 + 3|2 + 0|2 = 10 gr 43 pf = 13|7.
- **May** (summary row '13 7 3|2 18|4'):
  - 13 received, 7 sent.
  - Convent.: 3|0 + 0|2 = 3|2.
  - Cassen: 0|6 + 0|4 + 0|2 + 4|6 + 0|4 + 1|8 + 2|10 + 1|6 + 3|4 + 3|2 = 14 gr 52 pf = 18|4.
- **June** (summary row '10 11 0|6 35|8'):
  - 10 received, 11 sent.
  - Convent.: 0|2 × 3 (Bode, Enke, Nicolai) = 0|6.
  - Cassen: 2|8 + 3|6 + 3|2 + 14|2 + 0|2 + 12|0 = 34 gr 20 pf = 35|8.
- **Half-year total** (summary row '79 56 33|2 119|2'):
  - Received: 11 + 8 + 23 + 14 + 13 + 10 = 79.
  - Sent: 8 + 10 + 10 + 10 + 7 + 11 = 56.
  - Convent.: 3|0 + 14|0 + 6|4 + 6|2 + 3|2 + 0|6 = 32 gr 14 pf = 33|2.
  - Cassen: 12|6 + 23|3 + 15|10 + 13|7 + 18|4 + 35|8 = 116 gr 38 pf = 119|2.
  - January and February figures are from the previous page.

The July lines at the bottom (3 v. Lindenau / Fraunhofer, 7 Olbers, 10 Nicolai) begin the next half-year. The numbers in the left margin belong to the facing (verso) page.
errors: No arithmetic errors: every monthly count and money total checks with 12 Pf = 1 Gr, provided the March totals include the 2–3 March entries from the previous page.

results.what: Monthly bookkeeping of letters received and sent, with postage totals in Groschen and Pfennig (base-12 carry)

deep.surprise_reason: This is Gauss's well-known correspondence register and postage ledger, a biographical source rather than mathematics. It is useful for dating letters (e.g. to Olbers, Bessel, Fraunhofer, Herschel and Pond in 1815) but contains no mathematical content.

April Cassen total is 13 gr 7 pf

Half-year Cassen total is 119 gr 2 pf
Half-year Convent. total is 33 gr 2 pf

transcription_corrections: Header columns are 'Conv.' and 'Cass. G.'; on the right page 'Convent.' and 'Cassen', each split into Groschen and Pfennig.
9 März: 'Me' in the Von column is struck out and so is not counted; Meineke is in the An column.
16 März: the '3 —' sits in the Cassen column.
27 März: the '4' sits in the Pfennig sub-column of the Convent. column; '20 März von Utzschneider' has Conv. 3|0 and Cass. 0|10.
15 Apr Olbers: Conv. 3|0 and Cass. 0|6 (an ink blot is over the groschen digit).
June 2[?]: the date reads '21'; there are two Olbers entries in the An column on the 19th/21st.
29 June v. Lindenau and Nicolai: the '— 2' entries are in the Convent. column (the June Conv. total is 0|6).
The left-margin numbers belong to the facing verso page and are not part of this page's accounts.
